arguments.text: Settle now, smooth and long, save it for later

6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Hold pod shaft power near critical (about 175-185 W) all race; a bit more into the current, a bit less with it. Keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1000 m to go, then finish sprint from about 400-500 m left. Watch for rudder weed (speed drop at same power), pod drift (pod vs boat power disagree), radio course changes.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; drops if drag rises (weed) at same pod power

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; shifts with pod drift or extra drag

arguments.text: Start: pod 260 W for first 105 s (critical 176), pod reserve fell to about 32 pct. Ease cue at 1.1 min took effect about 40 s later; by 2.3 min instant pod power about 178 W. Leg 1 (north) is into current, push about -0.18 m/s. Boat/pod power ratio about 0.69-0.70 early.

text: no cue: pod power already falling from 260 to about critical after the ease cue; reserve 32 pct, holding.

arguments.text: 5.2 min, 956 m: pod about 180 W (critical 176), pod reserve 26 pct slowly falling; boat model says 118 W, below its critical 123, boat reserve rising to 43 pct. Boat/pod ratio drifted 0.68 to 0.65 over leg 1. Leg 1 north push -0.14 to -0.15.

text: no cue: paddler steady at about critical pod power before the first turn; tightened the pod/boat ratio watch.

arguments.text: You are right on target. Smooth rhythm, the start pain fades.

Data: pod 179 W steady at critical 176, rate 60, not collapsing; pod reserve 25 pct, boat reserve 44 pct rising. Reassured. If pod power sags below about 165 W without a cue, critical power may be set too high: consider set_critical_power.

arguments.text: 6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back; north legs (1,3,5) into current about -0.15, south legs (2,4,6) with it about +0.15 to +0.2. Pod reserve is the effort gauge (24 pct at 6 min after a hot start); boat reserve reads higher (42 pct). Average pod about 177 W: ease a touch to about 170 on south legs, about 182-185 on north legs. Finish sprint from about 450 m left on leg 6. Paddler said cooked at 6 min (8/10) while holding critical: keep them calm, watch for sag. Watch rudder weed, pod drift, radio course changes.

no cue: paddler eased on their own to about 168 W pod on the with-current leg, which is the plan; reserve refilling, no fade.

arguments.text: Current is helping here. Breathe, long strokes, you are doing fine.

7.6 min leg 2: paddler 9/10 hurting. Pod fell 182 to 163 W (at about 395 s and creeping since) with rate 60 constant; GPS dipped only 3.34 to 3.29 then flat; boat/pod ratio 0.66 on leg 1 to 0.73 now. Two readings: (a) critical power set too high and paddler fading, or (b) pod drifting low. TEST on leg 3 north: leg 1 had pod about 179 W for GPS about 2.95 m/s into push -0.15. If GPS about 2.95 with pod reading about 160, pod is drifting low; if GPS about 2.85, real fade, lower critical.

text: Reassured on the with-current leg: paddler 9/10 and pod power sagging but GPS speed mostly held; will test pod drift vs real fade on leg 3.

arguments.text: 8.8 min, 1665 m: pod down to 154 W while GPS speed rose 3.29 to 3.40 m/s at constant rate 60; boat model 131 W (above its critical 123), speed at same rate +3.1 pct vs early; push_local 0.41 vs fitted 0.20; gap grew steadily about 0.05 per min since 6 min. Leaning: pod reading drifting low (gain falling), not a fade. Alternative: stronger tailwind/current on south leg plus paddler easing. Decide on leg 3 north after turn at 2000 m: compare GPS speed vs leg 1 (2.95 at pod 179).

text: no cue: pod and boat power now disagree (pod falling, boat speed rising at same rate), likely pod drift; waiting for the north leg to confirm.

arguments.message: speed through water at same stroke rate down over 3 pct vs early race: real fade or drag

text: no cue: pod still falling while boat speed holds at same rate, likely pod drift; replaced the pod-sag watch with a boat-speed fade watch; confirm on the north leg.

arguments.reason: clean leg-3 GPS speed (30-s means clear the turn): pod drift vs fade test

text: no cue: just past the turn, 30-s means still include the turn; waking in 40 s for a clean leg-3 reading.

arguments.text: 11.4 min, leg 3 north: CONFIRMED pod drifting low. GPS 2.97 m/s into current (leg 1: 2.95 at pod 179) with pod now reading 146 W; rate 60 same. Pod power, pod reserve (reads 54 pct, false) and push_local are unreliable from about 6 min on. Use boat model: power_w about 125-129 W vs boat critical 123, boat reserve 33 pct falling, fitted push -0.22 north / +0.2 south.

POD IS DRIFTING LOW since about 6 min: ignore shaft power, pod reserve, push_local. Gauge = boat model (power_w vs critical 123 W, reserve_left_pct, fitted push about 0.2 m/s). 6 legs of 1000 m: north legs 3 and 5 into current, hold boat about 125-128 W; south legs 4 and 6 with current, about 118-121 W. Keep boat reserve above about 15 pct until 600 m to go, then finish sprint from about 450 m left on leg 6 (ask finish). Paddler reports 8-9/10 hurting at critical: keep calm, reassure, no extra pushes. Watch rudder weed (fade_pct drop), radio course changes.

Model says that is leaving time (sustainable about 126 W). Cued push to 151 s/500 ground on with-current leg 4 (leg 2 at about 120 W was 3.30-3.38 m/s). Into current on leg 5 target about 166-168 s/500 ground.

arguments.text: WIND from north 8-12 kn since 18.6 min (radio): tailwind on south legs, headwind on north leg 5. Boat model now treats wind as the paddler (reads high on south legs, low on north) until turns refit the push. POD drifted low 6-10 min but its gain is STABLE since 10 min: boat-equivalent effort = 0.89 x pod shaft power. Use pod as effort gauge now: pod about 136 = boat 121. Leg 5 north (into wind + current, will be slow, maybe 180-190 s/500): hold effort, pod about 140-145, NO pace target. Leg 6 south (tailwind + current): pod about 138, finish sprint from about 450 m left (ask finish). Paddler suffers at pod above 145 (said cannot keep it up on leg 3). Cue just before turn 4 to cancel the 151 pace target.

18.7 min, 3490 m: radio says wind from north 8-12 kn filling in. On leg 4 south GPS 3.37 (148 s/500) with pod steady 133-136; boat model jumped to 128 W from the tailwind. eff_ratio (boat/pod) stable 0.88-0.91 from 10 to 18 min, so pod gain stopped drifting: pod x 0.89 = effort in boat watts. Rough estimate: into 10 kn headwind + 0.2 current, pace at the same effort maybe 180-190 s/500.

text: no cue: wind from the north now helps this south leg; paddler steady; plan switched to effort by the pod (gain stable since 10 min) and a hold-effort cue before the headwind turn.

arguments.text: Into wind and current now. Dig in steady, ignore the pace.

text: Cued push with no pace target before the turn into wind and current (cancels the 151 target); boat-reserve alert is the tailwind fooling the boat model, pod effort was below critical.

arguments.text: 21.9 min, leg 5 north: GPS 186 s/500 into wind + current (matches estimate), pod 150 (boat-equivalent about 133 W, 10 over critical), rate 60, paddler 7/10 really hurting. Estimated true reserve about 38 pct (3.2 kJ boat scale) at 20.5 min: pod 150 for all of leg 5 would spend most of it. Boat model reserve and pod reserve are both wrong now (wind, pod drift). Plan: let them hold leg 5; leg 6 tailwind at about critical, finish sprint from about 450 m.

True reserve estimate 25-30 pct; pod 150 to the turn would nearly empty it, so cued ease to 188 s/500 (pod about 142). Must cancel this pace target before last turn (leg 6 tailwind).

text: Cued a slight ease to 188 s/500 into the headwind to keep reserve for the finish; no weed seen, the heavy feeling matches the headwind turn.
